notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Below are the changes for this update. Please note that your OLD save file may not function correctly and you may need to start a new game.

[ADDED] - Rainbow Shapes, Roombas & related Upgrades.
[ADDED] - Scroll Wheel Zoom in/out for tech tree.

[REMOVED] - All upgrades that reward the user with just 'Points'.

tags.feature: [ADDED] - Scroll Wheel Zoom in/out for tech tree.
[REMOVED] - All upgrades that reward the user with just 'Points'.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[u]Small update to address a few issues.[/u]

[b][FIXED] [/b]- Tech tree panning. Before this update sometimes panning in the tech tree was hard to do as "Right Clicking" was not called correctly

[b][FIXED][/b] - Readability of most TEXT in the game.

[b][FIXED][/b] - The game will no longer pause when a UI popup activates. E.G, Leveling up, Tech tree window, etc

[b][ADDED] [/b]- Auto Merge Button. Added a auto merge button as it became hard to merge your PolyBots in the late game.
